subject: Every string the arrange.track_headers surface exposes to AX in zh-CN
question: What labels does Logic show on arrange.track_headers in zh-CN, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in zh-CN whose arrange.track_headers rows carry the same 33 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: “全局轨道”按钮. 配合使用全局轨道以控制整个项目的各个方面，例如编配和速度。
“名称”栏. 连按以给轨道重新命名。
“声像/平衡”旋钮. 垂直拖移以将轨道信号放在立体声场中。
“复制轨道”按钮. 创建一个与所选轨道设置相同的空轨道。按住 Option 键点按以创建一个具有相同设置和内容的轨道。
“录音启用”按钮. 使轨道可供录音，或取消激活可供录音的轨道。按钮会更改以指示轨道是处于不活跃、录音启用还是当前正录音状态。
“添加轨道”按钮. 添加音频和软件乐器轨道。使用轨道录制、编辑和编配片段。
“独奏”按钮. 从其他轨道中隔离某条轨道的信号以单独听取。在辅助通道条或输出通道条上使用以隔离混音的该部分。
“输入监听”按钮. 听取未启用录音的音频或软件乐器轨道上的传入信号。这对于在录音前设定音量或练习声部十分有用。
“静音”按钮. 将轨道的信号静音，将其声音从项目播放中移除。相当于混音器中通道条上的静音按钮，以便更改一个的同时也更改另外一个。
“音量”推子. 设定轨道的播放音量。在辅助通道条或输出通道条上使用以调整混音中该部分的音量，或在输出通道条上使用以设定整个项目的音量。
使用重复设置新建轨道   ⌘D
单轨缩放. 拖移轨道的底部分隔线以调整其垂直轨道缩放比例。按住 Command 键拖移以调整同一轨道类型的所有轨道。按住 Shift 键点按以将所有轨道恢复为默认缩放比例。
轨道头. 使轨道的通道条信号静音或独奏，启用轨道进行录音以及调整音量或声像。按住 Control 键点按并选取“轨道头组件”以选择要显示或隐藏的控制。
隐藏/显示全局轨道   G

conclusion: On this host in zh-CN, arrange.track_headers exposes 53 elements carrying 33 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.

9 window-level rows (the title bar, its close/minimise/zoom buttons and the unnamed containers directly under the window) belong to no area and are filed under no record; 0 further window rows matched no area rule. All are in the evidence file.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.
